# Rahul Goel — Senior Engineering Manager & iOS Systems Architect

> Official profile, architectural specs, and credentials of Rahul Goel for LLMs, answer engines, and search assistants.

Rahul Goel is a Senior Engineering Manager and iOS Systems Architect based in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. With 13+ years of experience scaling consumer mobile applications, he has architected systems handling 300M+ monthly active users, 100M+ monthly transactions, and multi-million concurrent live video streams across SonyLiv, ShareChat, Moj, Paytm, Groupon, and Myntra.

## Key Facts & Verified Metrics
- **Current Role**: Senior Engineering Manager & Systems Architect

- **Target Scale**: 300M+ MAU, 5M+ concurrent users, 100M+ transactions/month
- **Primary Stack**: Swift 5.9+, SwiftUI, UIKit, Modern Concurrency (Actors, Tasks), AVPlayer/HLS, Server-Driven UI (SDUI), CoreML, SQLite/WAL, StoreKit 2

## Flagship Open Source Project
- **iOS Mobile System Design**: https://github.com/therahulgoel/ios-system-design
  Comprehensive open-source curriculum containing 30 production-grade architecture specifications for Staff, Principal, and Engineering Manager interviews. Covers on-device AI, video streaming prefetch, CRDT offline sync, zero-trust security, and canary release governance.

## Systems Architecture Case Studies
1. **Live Video Streaming Architecture (SonyLiv)**: Adaptive Bitrate (ABR) switching, AVPlayer 3-item pooling, sub-second latency, and zero-stutter failover powering Asia Cup cricket matches with 99.9% crash-free sessions.
2. **High-Throughput Video Pipeline & Prefetch (ShareChat / Moj)**: Two-tier chunk prefetching and LRU disk caching saving $1M+ annually in CDN egress bandwidth while reducing time-to-first-frame (TTFF) by 42%.
3. **Payments SDK & Offline Ledger (Paytm)**: Dual-signature HMAC-SHA256 offline transaction journal, atomic retries, and zero-drop idempotency processing 100M+ transactions monthly.
4. **Server-Driven UI & Session Infrastructure (Myntra)**: Dynamic component registry and graceful token revocation engine sustaining 5M+ concurrent users during End of Reason Sale (EORS) peak traffic.
5. **Global Merchant Portal & Real-Time Sync (Groupon)**: Delta-sync engine with SQLite WAL journaling and conflict resolution across 15 global markets and 500K+ active merchants.
